capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Spec list: 28.9 kWh net. 2020-2024 compared: no pack change (same 12-module pack through MY2024).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: the Cooper SE pack uses 93.2 Ah cells (InsideEVs) matching the i3 94 Ah Samsung SDI cells, which Wikipedia lists as NMC; no MINI page names the chemistry.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: 32.6 kWh / 93.2 Ah cells is about 350 V, the same class as the i3 (352-355 V).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Digital Trends found charge times "substantially longer if the battery wasn't thoroughly warmed up first" and describes no pre-conditioning feature; no MINI owner's manual read. Owner may want to check the manual.

dc_max_kw.notes: Spec list: DC fast charging 0-80 % in 35 min "at up to around 50 kW" (Digital Trends: maximum 50 kW).

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Digital Trends (US car) says "equipped with a 7.4-kilowatt onboard charger" (MINI US kit says the same but could not be read). Europe has an 11 kW three-phase option (InsideEVs, Wikipedia).
